title: MAP for Broadband Funding Act

claims.claim: Directs the FCC, in coordination with the NTIA, to collect data / keep the Broadband Funding Map up to date
claims.sourceSpan: collect data submitted for the Broadband Funding Map by relevant Federal agencies on a reasonable and timely basis
claims.note: 'keep the map up to date' glosses 'collect... on a reasonable and timely basis'.

claims.claim: The FCC will seek public input on improving the map
claims.note: Source directs a 'notice of inquiry concerning the optimum functionality and transparency'; it never states the inquiry seeks public input/comment. That is procedural inference about notices of inquiry, not text.

claims.claim: Orders a GAO study of how well agencies maintain the map
claims.sourceSpan: conduct a study on the roles, responsibilities, and progress to date of Federal agencies to maintain the Broadband Funding Map

claims.claim: The map tracks where federal broadband-deployment dollars go
claims.note: Bill defines the Broadband Funding Map only by cross-reference to section 60105(a) IIJA (unfetched 'Deployment Locations Map'); the source itself does not describe what the map shows.

claims.claim: The map's purpose is to prevent paying twice to wire the same area
claims.sourceSpan: prevent inefficient use or fragmentation of Federal funding for broadband infrastructure
claims.note: Plain-English gloss; engrossed source says 'prevent inefficient use or fragmentation', not 'paying twice/overbuilding' (that wording was removed pre-engrossment per versionChanges).

claims.claim: Requires the FCC to modernize the Broadband Funding Map
claims.sourceSpan: BROADBAND FUNDING MAP MODERNIZATION

claims.claim: Requires the FCC to seek public comment on the map
claims.note: Source says 'notice of inquiry'; 'public comment' is not stated in the text.

claims.claim: Orders a GAO study of how federal agencies maintain it
claims.sourceSpan: roles, responsibilities, and progress to date of Federal agencies to maintain the Broadband Funding Map

claims.claim: What the Broadband Funding Map Does
claims.sourceSpan: Broadband Funding Map
claims.note: Descriptive headline; map is a defined term.

claims.claim: Federal map showing the location of each federally funded broadband project
claims.note: Map defined only by cross-reference to 60105(a) IIJA (the 'Deployment Locations Map'); source does not describe its contents. Reasonable inference from the defined name, but not in fetched source.

claims.claim: Meant to prevent redundant overbuilding with federal funds
claims.sourceSpan: prevent inefficient use or fragmentation of Federal funding for broadband infrastructure
claims.note: 'redundant overbuilding' is superseded introduced-version wording; engrossed source says 'inefficient use or fragmentation'. Same concept, removed phrase.

claims.sourceSpan: collect data submitted for the Broadband Funding Map by relevant Federal agencies on a reasonable and timely basis

claims.claim: Reviews whether the FCC has authority to collect the needed data

claims.claim: Names the Act the "Modernization, Accountability, and Planning for Broadband Funding Act" (the "MAP for Broadband Funding Act")
claims.sourceSpan: Modernization, Accountability, and Planning for Broadband Funding Act

claims.claim: Short-title section, citation name only, no substantive effect
claims.sourceSpan: SHORT TITLE

claims.sourceSpan: appropriate congressional committees
claims.note: All five defined terms present as (1)-(5).

claims.claim: 'Commission' means the FCC

claims.sourceSpan: How enhanced use of the Broadband Funding Map by relevant Federal agencies could improve taxpayer savings

claims.claim: Study reviews feasibility and potential benefits of incorporating third-party mapping data
claims.sourceSpan: The feasibility and potential benefits of incorporating third-party mapping data into the Broadband Funding Map

claims.sourceSpan: not later than 270 days after the date of enactment of this Act, the Commission shall initiate a notice of inquiry

claims.claim: The FCC's data collection is tied to preventing "redundant overbuilding of broadband infrastructure with Federal funding"
claims.sourceSpan: prevent inefficient use or fragmentation of Federal funding for broadband infrastructure
claims.note: Quoted phrase 'redundant overbuilding of broadband infrastructure with Federal funding' does NOT appear in the engrossed source; 3(a) says 'prevent inefficient use or fragmentation of Federal funding for broadband infrastructure'. The overbuilding wording is the superseded introduced-version text (see versionChanges) presented here as a current direct quote.

claims.claim: Labels Section 3(a) as the "overbuilding purpose"
claims.sourceSpan: prevent inefficient use or fragmentation of Federal funding for broadband infrastructure
claims.note: Section 3(a) contains no 'overbuilding' language in the engrossed text.

claims.claim: The bill orders an FCC inquiry and a GAO study but does not require the FCC to act on the findings or change the map
claims.sourceSpan: the Commission shall complete the inquiry
claims.note: No provision requires acting on findings; bill mandates only inquiry (Sec 3) and study (Sec 4).

claims.claim: The bill aims to prevent redundant overbuilding but creates no enforcement mechanism to stop duplicative funding
claims.sourceSpan: prevent inefficient use or fragmentation of Federal funding for broadband infrastructure
claims.note: 'redundant overbuilding' is the removed wording; the 'no enforcement mechanism' observation is accurate (bill contains none).

claims.claim: The bill directs review of FCC data-collection authority but does not itself grant the FCC new authority to compel agency data
claims.sourceSpan: Whether the Commission has sufficient authority to collect the necessary data
claims.note: Bill orders a review of authority; grants none.

claims.claim: The bill lists agencies whose coordination GAO must review but does not require those agencies to submit data on a fixed schedule
claims.sourceSpan: the Department of Agriculture, the Department of Health and Human Services
claims.note: Agencies listed for GAO review; no fixed submission schedule mandated in the bill.

notes: Engrossed-in-Senate text (S.2585 ES), 6728 chars, read in full. No referencedSources registered; the Broadband Funding Map / broadband infrastructure definitions live in section 60105(a) IIJA (47 U.S.C. 1704), which is NOT fetched — map-description claims (what the map shows) are therefore UNSUPPORTED from fetched source (minor). One MATERIAL issue: underreported[1] presents 'redundant overbuilding of broadband infrastructure with Federal funding' as a current direct quote, but that phrase is the superseded introduced-version wording; the engrossed text says 'prevent inefficient use or fragmentation of Federal funding for broadband infrastructure'. versionChanges and featured_quotes (CR floor quote) were not decomposed — the former needs the introduced text and the latter the Congressional Record, neither in scope for source-only audit. Stage/vote cross-check: 'Passed the Senate June 18, 2026' in source matches votes[] and stage 'Passed Senate' — no drift.
